entity: No company board seats, shareholdings or business activity declared
detail: In his declarations of 13 December 2023, 31 December 2023 and 31 December 2025, Tusk states that he is not a member of the management, supervisory or audit board of any commercial company, cooperative or business-running foundation, is not employed by and does not perform other work for commercial companies, holds no shares in them, and conducts no business activity on his own account or jointly with others.
